user.title: FunASR Realtime STT
user.description:
Speech-to-text for Assist, powered by FunASR models.

Choose the recognition backend.

cloud.title: Cloud backend — Aliyun Bailian (DashScope)
cloud.description: fun-asr-realtime streaming recognition over the public DashScope API.

data_description.api_key: Aliyun Bailian API key (classic sk- format, valid on dashscope.aliyuncs.com). Token-plan/MaaS endpoint keys do NOT work for the public ASR API.
data_description.workspace: Only needed if the key belongs to a sub-workspace (llm- prefix).

local.title: Local backend — FunASR runtime
local.description: Recognize speech on a self-hosted FunASR runtime server (2pass WebSocket). Audio never leaves your LAN.

data_description.server_url: WebSocket URL of the FunASR runtime server, e.g. ws://192.168.31.8:10095 (plain ws, default port 10095).

error.invalid_api_key: API key rejected by DashScope (401/403). Note: token-plan/MaaS keys cannot access the public ASR API.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach DashScope to validate the key.
error.cannot_connect_server: Could not open a WebSocket to the FunASR runtime server. Check the URL and that the server is running.

data.auto_hotwords: Auto-collect device & area names as hotwords
data.vocab_prefix: Hotword vocabulary prefix (cloud backend; lowercase letters/digits, <10 chars)
